headline: Bosch Sensortec posts a PhD role applying agentic AI to ASIC and mixed-signal verification
fact: Bosch Sensortec posted a Dresden PhD role to develop agentic-AI software for accelerating ASIC design, verification, and test. The posting explicitly includes mixed-signal verification and testing and names coverage-driven regression optimization, AMS testbench generation, and closed-loop test-case evaluation and optimization among its example use cases.

sources.title: PhD - Agentic AI for ASIC Development Acceleration
sources.summary: Official Bosch posting REF292240Q, published July 24, 2026 by Bosch Sensortec GmbH in Dresden, covering agentic-AI work across ASIC design, verification, test, mixed-signal verification, regressions, AMS testbenches, and test-case optimization.
